Definition: from G4663 and a derivative of G977; worm-eaten, i.e. diseased with maggots:--eaten of worms.
BiblicalUsage: Skolekobrotos means eaten of worms, and it appears once, where the angel of the Lord smote Herod because he gave not God the glory, and he was eaten of worms and gave up the ghost.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Herod's worms are the judgment on a man who took God's glory, because the crowd's praise turned to rot the moment he accepted it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
